meta.size_m: [length, width] in metres, length the long side; null = size to confirm (closest written evidence given)
meta.precedence: per unit: 2026 contract line naming the unit (asset number, else the reference at the head of the description) > iEDM programme row > 2025 contract row > card product line > fleet guide row whose description matches the contract. The project manager's recorded direction overrides all of these where he gave one (waste tanks).
meta.door_rule_finding: No written document (contracts, programme, schedule, card, fleet guide, Event Portables sheets, 2025 papers) says which wall a door is on. The only written door facts are: the Schedule 6 BOQ marks one 6 m building "2 doors"; toilet blocks are Female / Male / Combo; and the record holds the project manager's loading door side per unit (driver / passenger / not applicable), which is what Arrange loads should offer. Door position on the unit comes from the drawing.
meta.rule: Every size cites a document cell/line or the record; "size to confirm" where nothing written exists. No manufacturer data from memory: generator, forklift, toilet, VMS and light-tower dimensions come only from the Coates Load Restraint Guide 2023 rows quoted.

Building 6m.size_basis: Every 2026 contract line for a 6 m building reads "Portable Building Shell 6.0M x 3.0M" (some "- Cyclonic Rated"); the iEDM programme and the 2025 contracts agree; the rate card line is "Portable Building - 6m x 3m". Length is the long side.
Building 6m.door_rule: One door is the norm in no written source; the Schedule 6 BOQ marks one 6 m building "2 doors" (BOQ!D74, reference not given). No written document says which wall the door is on; that comes only from the drawing (see the drawings catalogue / v9.15 door.faces). Loading door side (which way the door faces on the truck) is the project manager's choice per unit on the record (loading872: door to driver side / door to passenger side / not applicable; v8.72-v8.73 READMEs). It is never set automatically, and the same choice is what Arrange loads should offer (STATUS.md, 9 Oct ~00:30: "Remember when we pick the loads we can select the driver to door selection here too. As we can see the door side on the pics.").
